method: imagegen — outil intégré, génération sans image de référence
note: Quatre paysages fictifs. Aucune photographie ni métadonnée des auteurs du site. Encodage WebP des sorties générées, sans recadrage.
prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one independent fictional fine-art landscape photograph for a photography gallery UI prototype, no reference images. Wide horizontal 3:2 composition. An immense Iceland-like black volcanic beach in overcast dusk, one luminous wave curls from upper right into a charcoal sand foreground, barely visible sea stacks on distant horizon. Natural silver tones, subtle blue shadows, rich tactile surf and sand, contemplative, credible large format camera photography. No people, text, watermark, framing, UI or collage. Pure photographic image, not an illustration.
